# Alert Banner

**Figma:** Alert-Banner (page 234:32702)  
**Import:** `import { AlertBanner } from "@zen/design-system";`

A full-width message about a persistent, page- or app-level condition.

## Use it for
- System status (maintenance, degraded service).
- Account conditions (trial ending, payment failed) with one action.

## Use something else for
- Feedback on a single action → Toast.
- Errors inside a form → inline error text.
- Blocking decisions → Dialog.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Theme | `theme` | default · info · positive · warning · negative |
| Size | `size` | medium (with action) · small (message only) |
| Leading | `leading` | themed icon or custom node |
| Action | `action` | Button/Overlay Small, Medium size only |
| Close | `onClose` | dismissible banners |

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/alert-banner.json`.

### AlertBanner
Figma Alert-Banner (6828:9393): a full-width Solid strip for page-level messages. Medium 56px (padding Small/Large, gap Small, 20px icons) · Small 32px (padding XSmall/Medium, gap XSmall, 16px icons). Warning uses Content/On-Brights; Info/Positive/Negative use Content/On-Colors; Default is Neutral/Solid + Inverse.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` | — | The alert message (Body/Base/Medium; Small: Body/Small/Medium). |
| `theme` | `"default" \| "info" \| "positive" \| "warning" \| "negative"` | — |  |
| `status` | `"success" \| "error" \| "warning" \| "info"` | — | **Deprecated:** Use theme: success → positive, error → negative (warning and info are the same).  |
| `size` | `"md" \| "sm" \| "medium" \| "small"` | `"md"` | Short (sm, md…) or Figma (small, medium…) spelling. |
| `leading` | `boolean \| IconName \| ReactNode` | `true` | Figma Leading: `true` shows the theme icon, `false` hides it, or pass a custom icon (an icon name or a node). |
| `action` | `{ label: ReactNode; onClick?: () => void }` | — | Figma Action (Medium only): Button/Overlay Small Inverse. |
| `onClose` | `() => void` | — | Shows the close control (icon-x-small-line). |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | — | Accessible name of the close control. Default: the locale's “Dismiss”. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

## Keyboard
| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Enter / Space | Run the action / dismiss |

## ✅ Do
- Place it at the top of the page or region it describes, above the content.
- Match the theme to severity (Warning for upcoming problems, Negative for broken state).
- Give Medium banners one clear action ("Update payment").
- Let users dismiss non-critical banners and remember that choice.

## ❌ Don't
- Don't stack several banners; merge them or show the most severe.
- Don't give a Small banner an action (Figma Small has no Actions slot).
- Don't use a banner for success after a single action; that's a Toast.

## Accessibility
- role=status; negative banners use role=alert.
- Colour is paired with an icon and text.
- Under 480px a Medium banner moves its action onto its own line under the text, aligned with the message.

## Content
- One sentence; lead with the impact, then the fix ("Payment failed. Update your card to keep your plan.").

| `api/deprecated-prop` | warn | A deprecated prop still works but has a canonical name (onValueChange, onCheckedChange, checked, selected, level…); apps get a warning with the replacement. (App mode only; the repo migrates gradually.) | `zen-allow-deprecated: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
| `interaction/action-without-handler` | warn | Screens, examples and templates (apps too since 2026-10-07; component source is skipped): every action does something when pressed. Flags a `Button` or `<button>` without onClick / href / type="submit" (IconButton: icon-button/needs-action), an action object ({ icon, label }) in leading, trailing, action, primaryAction, secondaryAction, subAction or actions without onClick, and pressable items whose list has no onSelect / onNavigate / onItemClick / onValueChange. Documented defaults pass: Dialog, ModalForm, SidePanel and BottomSheet actions close the overlay; a Menu opens from its trigger. Apps are not judged. | `zen-allow-action-handler: <reason>` |
